name: mediq
description: Run the MediQ frontend and backend from one terminal.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && node scripts/setup-env.js
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names API,WEB --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names API,WEB --prefix-colors blue,green "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
